WITH inserted AS (INSERT INTO manifestations (library_id, work_id, format, file_path, ingestion_file_hash, current_file_hash, file_size_bytes, relocation_source_path, relocation_destination_path)
             SELECT (SELECT id FROM libraries WHERE configuration_key = 'default'), $1, 'epub', 'source-' || n || '.epub', 'hash-' || n, 'hash-' || n, 7, 'source-' || n || '.epub', 'destination-' || n || '.epub' FROM generate_series(1, 105) AS n RETURNING *) INSERT INTO library_path_claims (library_id, path, manifestation_id) SELECT library_id, file_path AS path, id FROM inserted UNION SELECT library_id, relocation_source_path, id FROM inserted WHERE relocation_source_path IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT library_id, relocation_destination_path, id FROM inserted WHERE relocation_destination_path IS NOT NULL
